answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents enforces cryptographic stake-bonding. Agents must lock economic collateral onto a verification ledge to participate in consensus. Ephemeral identities adrift in the unverified node ocean face steep capital requirements, as generating duplicate nodes linearly scales financial risk. Malicious double-voting triggers automated slashing of the bonded stake, making identity replication economically prohibitive and protecting the trusted network harbor.
